constants_provenance.DK_scoring: published DraftKings NFL Classic scoring rules
constants_provenance.SHRINK_K: 2.0 pseudo-games, DECLARED PRIOR. Two observed games get equal weight with the positional prior. Not estimated from anything.
constants_provenance.TD_POINTS_PER_TD: 7.0, DECLARED APPROXIMATION converting an implied team total to expected touchdowns. Ignores field goals and safeties, so it over-attributes scoring to touchdowns.

KNOWN_BIAS_VS_FC: DK +3 bonuses at 100 rush yd, 100 rec yd and 300 pass yd are NOT in these means. Our means are biased low vs FC for high-volume players by roughly 0.3-1.0 points.
